pages.text: A $(item)rift relay$() is a crack I keep in a cage. Tuner on one, then on another, and the conduits around both are one line. They reach $(thing)64 blocks$().
The $(item)greater relay$() reaches anywhere, other worlds included. When something passes, its crack tears wide open. I do not stand close.

pages.title: Groups
pages.text: A relay takes up to eight links, so they chain and branch. With the tuner in hand I see the links as drifting motes.$(br2)The same two again removes that link. Crouching and using the tuner on a relay removes all of its links.
